intent: Run an iterative refine loop: review the current draft by asking whether to accept it, revise once more, or escalate to a human editor, and score its quality; route accept and escalate to STOP but route revise back into the review node, then merge the open probabilities before stopping.

known_steps.text: the workflow runs at most 8 iterations
a choice question "verdict" asks "Should we accept the draft, revise it once more, or escalate to a human editor?"
a score question "quality" asks "How good is the current draft?"

unknown_steps.text: the answer "revise" returns to the node "review"
the workflow can run for at most 8 iterations
